$description: agentos foundations. Source of truth for tokens.css. Themes map: base holds what both themes share, light and dark lay over it.

display.$description: Home's sentence. One per app, at most.

section-title.$description: A section of a page, a dialog title.

page-title-compact.$description: The page title, and Home's sentence, on a phone.

lede.$description: The sentence under a page title. text.secondary.

card-title.$description: The title of a card, a sheet section, a list group.

table-header.$description: Column heads. text.tertiary, sentence case, no band.

secondary.$description: A row's second line, descriptions. text.secondary.

caption.$description: Timestamps, footnotes, help under a field. text.tertiary.

number.$description: Numbers in tables and lists: tabular figures, right aligned.

stat.$description: The big number of a stat tile. Tabular figures.

code.$description: Ids, hashes, branches, commands, terminal output.

code-caption.$description: A command, branch or id on a row's second line.

eyebrow.$description: A kind's word over a card title, a section's label. The one caps style.

micro.$description: Avatar initials and keyboard keys only.

mark.$description: The ring of a hollow status mark.

offset.$description: Outline offset of the focus ring; inset rings use -2px.

card.$description: Cards, tables, panels: one step off the page.

inset.$description: Wells: code, pictures waiting to load, card footers. Never a table header.

raised.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets. Always with a shadow.

inverse.$description: Tooltips and toasts: the one inverted surface.

line.$description: A hairline on the inverse surface.

strong.$description: A skeleton's band, a quiet bar on a well.

default.$description: Every hairline: cards, rows, header bottom.

strong.$description: Hovered control edge, input edge, a divider that must hold.

control.$description: Checkbox, radio and switch edges: 3:1 against any surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

primary.$description: Titles, cell values, anything read first.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast, never for something to read.

inverse.$description: Text on surface.inverse and on solid fills.

text.$description: Links (underlined) and the selected tab's word. Ink, not a hue.

fill.$description: Checked checkbox, switch on, selected chip, progress that is not a status.

soft.$description: A selected row or item: tint under text.

line.$description: A selected item's edge, a drop target.

ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring. 3:1 against every surface. The one blue.

text.$description: An agent acting right now. Ink; the ringed, pulsing dot says it.
Queued, sleeping, skipped: no colour, a hollow mark.

bg.$description: A terminal or log block. Dark in both themes.

mark.$description: The + sign and the gutter edge.
The - sign and the gutter edge.

line.$description: A sparkline's stroke: data reads in text colour.

bar.$description: A bar in a small chart.

bar-strong.$description: The bar that is the point (now, this run). Ink.

grid.$description: Chart gridlines and the bar track.

color-hover.$description: The soft drop under a card that lifts on hover.

card.$description: The top edge of a card, dark only.

wire.$description: A wire on a board: a hairline a step off the surface.

wire-strong.$description: A wire that carries something now.

mark.$description: Registration crosses on a board's corners.

dot.$description: The dotted grid of a board or a picture stage.

1.$description: A Site API field's hue: marks and wires only.

night.$description: The night band on a day line: the hours the person was asleep.

mark.$description: Tests: a suite run with agentos run.
Design: ui_check, ui_diff, a brand change.
Build and CI: a build, an install, lint and types.
Dev server: a service that stays on.
